diagnosis: The existing proof is valid but duplicates the two simulation directions and manually reconstructs witnesses. Case-splitting on the choice transition first lets `grind` discharge the small, symmetric bisimulation obligations with substantially less proof syntax.
proof_body:
by
  intro h
  use @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  intro s₁ s₂ hs μ
  cases hs with
  | choice h =>
    obtain ⟨R, hpq, hR⟩ := h
    constructor <;> intro s' ht <;> cases ht <;>
      grind [IsBisimulation, ChoiceBisim]
  | bisim h => grind [IsBisimulation, ChoiceBisim]
